# Rusty Shipp

> Living Waters won Song of the Year (Rock) at the Josie Music Awards in 2023. The band's albums are concept albums built around nautical themes.

## Facts
- Who: Rusty Shipp is a nautical rock and alternative band.
- Genre: Nautical rock, Alternative, Acoustic
- Based in: Nashville, TN
- Latest release: Dark Side of the Ocean (2022)
- Next show: None announced right now.
- Booking: booking@rustyshipp.com

## Music
- Dark Side of the Ocean (2022): Release page https://www.jesusfreakhideout.com/news/2022/04/07.RustyShippReleasesNewSingleKingoftheDeep.asp
- Liquid Exorcist (2019): Release page https://maximumvolumemusic.com/featured-band-rusty-shipp/
- Mortal Ghost (2017): Release page https://maximumvolumemusic.com/featured-band-rusty-shipp/
